about_the_game:
Content included in the beta version:

Levels 1-1 to 1-6, 2-1 to 2-6, 3-1, including two Quantum Warp levels and two Speed of Light Escape levels, as well as one Strange Space level, totaling 13 main levels and 5 side levels. All equipment and skill unlocks are synchronized with level progress.

Complete game introduction:

Exo Wanderer is an indie game developed by a solo creator.

The story is set on Gliese 667Ce, 22 light-years away from Earth, where Earth’s civilization is in deep crisis. You can play as Du Hao or Zoey, one of the Exo Wanderers, or team up with a friend to control two characters on the same device. Each Exo Wanderer has their own unique tank. Explore this mysterious planet in hopes of finding a way to save Earth’s civilization.


  • Local Co-op, Dual-Stick Combat

Play with a friend on the same screen, controlling two tanks to defeat all enemies and defend your base.


  • Dynamic Levels, Always Be Alert

Upgrade speed and turret levels through pickups, but beware—taking damage may cause downgrades, so stay alert to maintain your tank’s level.

  • Multiple Ammo Types, Combo Attacks

Collect various ammo through pickups, like fire or ice rounds, or even call in airstrikes. You can even launch a nuclear missile!

  • Shared Control, Two Become One

With two players, you can both control one tank—one drives, the other attacks.

  • Deployable Turrets, Defend Your Base

Freely deploy turrets or obstacles to stop enemies from reaching your base.

  • Galactic Blessings

Restore health with the Galactic Blessing, but be careful—choosing the wrong target could summon a meteor strike.

  • Quantum State, Supply Your Partner

If one player is destroyed, they enter Quantum State and can use elements to supply the remaining player.

  • A Rich Variety of Enemies

With over 1,000 types of enemies, you'll also encounter mysterious and powerful foes.

  • Diverse Equipment

Assemble or synthesize equipment using parts and particle energy fragments.


  • Nuclear Fusion, Elemental Synthesis

Use nuclear fusion to combine elements, crafting parts or particle energy fragments.


  • Single-Player Mode

If you prefer a solo experience, you can enjoy 100% of the story and levels.

  • Galactic History

Join Du Hao and Zoey as they uncover the mysteries of human civilization and the history of the galaxy.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10 64-bit
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Dual Core Processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 660, Radeon RX 460 or equivalent with 2 GB of video RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10 64-bit
  • Processor: 3.2 GHz Dual Core Processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 970, Radeon RX 580 or equivalent with 4GB of video RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

short_description: This is a sci-fi top-down tank shooting game that can be played solo or with two players. As human civilization is on the brink of extinction, you will take on the role of one or two "Exo Wanderers," seeking the truth of the Galactic and Earth civilizations on Gliese 667Ce.

*languages with full audio support
